name: Waypoint
description: A modern web application built with a focus on seamless user experience and robust functionality. Features an intuitive interface and responsive design.

name: Cinexium - Discover Trending Movies & TV Shows
description: The ultimate cinema tracking experience. Discover trending entertainment, dive deep into cast and crew details, watch high-quality trailers, and keep track of your favorite films and shows with a custom watchlist.

name: Betzy - Free Music App
description: A modern, fast, and seamless music streaming application. Discover new tracks, manage your playlists, and enjoy an immersive audio experience with a sleek and responsive interface.

name: Notely - Modern Notes App
description: A modern, fast, and secure notes application built with Next.js 15. Features a clean, distraction-free interface for capturing ideas, managing tasks, and staying organized.

name: Taskey - Task Management System
description: A full-stack task management web application built with React and Laravel. Users can securely register, login, manage personal tasks, track completed tasks, and view task statistics through a clean dashboard UI. Features include authentication with Laravel Sanctum, CRUD operations for tasks, protected API routes, responsive design, and real-time task status management.

name: Portfolio
description: A responsive personal portfolio website built with React and Tailwind CSS to showcase projects, skills, and contact information. Designed with smooth animations, clean layout, and optimized for performance across all devices.
